standard.summary: 独立验证集目录。填了这里就不会从训练集切图
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: A separate validation set directory. Fill this in and no images are split off the training set
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 独立验证集目录。填了这里就不会从训练集切图；用户可以手动复制一部分图片和 caption 到这个目录，用于计算验证 loss

advanced_en.principle: Standalone validation-set directory. When set, validation images are not carved out of the training set; manually copy some images and captions into this directory to compute validation loss.
